prg.title: Time programme
prg.formats: Import accepts: the Excel template, MS Project exports to Excel or XML, Primavera P6 exports to Excel or XER.
prg.cycleTitle: Generate the programme by floor cycle
prg.cycleHint: For each stage: its start on the first floor, the days one floor takes, and after how many days the next floor starts. Floors ({{n}}) follow the order of the project structure. Whole-project stages take a start and a duration only.
prg.cycleReplace: Only the chosen stages are replaced.
prg.importHint: {{all}} rows in the file, {{ok}} linked to a stage and location. Check and correct the links; rows without them are not imported. Several rows on one cell take the earliest start and the latest finish.
prg.importReplace: Only the cells found in the file are replaced.
prg.none: No approved programme yet. The contractor submits it and supervision approves it.
prg.cycleHow:
1. Tick the stage (it is ticked as soon as you fill a field).
2. Either its start on the first floor ({{first}}), or a link to an earlier stage: e.g. block walls 7 days "after its end" of the structure. When linked, the start of every floor is computed from the same floor of the earlier stage.
3. Duration: the days the stage takes on one floor.
4. Idle days between floors: empty days between a floor ending and the next starting (0 = the next day). For overlapping trades choose "from its start". With a link the crew still never starts a floor before finishing the one below: the later of the two wins.
Example: structure starts 1/12, 21 days, 2 idle days → {{first}} 1/12 to 21/12, {{second}} 24/12 to 13/1, and so on for all {{n}} floors.
5. Press Generate, check and adjust by hand, then Save. Calendar days. Hover the "from → to" column to see every floor.
prg.predMissing: Computed once the earlier stage has dates
prg.predMissingList: Stages linked to a stage without dates yet: {{list}}. Generate or enter the earlier stage first.
prg.draftHint: Changes to this programme from {{at}} were not saved. Restore them?
prg.clearConfirm: Clear all dates, cycle and link settings and start again? Nothing is saved until you press Save, and you can undo before that.
prg.shiftHint: Every date (generated, entered by hand, whole-project stages) moves by the same number of days, and so do the floor-cycle starts; durations and links stay. Current start: {{from}}.
prg.driftTitle: Dates that do not follow the links
prg.drift: These stages have dates other than their links and floor cycle give: {{list}}. This happens when dates are edited by hand after generating, or stages are generated in parts. The result: false float and a short critical path.
